How we prepare you

A proven method for screening tests

Government recruitment starts with a screening test. Our whole system is built to get you through it — and beyond.

01

Specialized mechanism for screening tests

A structured, test-focused routine designed around the pattern of FPSC, SPSC, NTS, STS and PTS screening papers.

02

Sharp focus on one-line MCQs

Topic-wise one-line MCQ practice — the exact format most government recruitment bodies use.

03

Discussion sessions alongside MCQs

Every MCQ block is followed by discussion, so concepts stick and you can handle twisted questions.
